overview.description: The SpaceXAI Lab Ecosystem ETF (XAIW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund investing in companies from around the world identified as most directly linked to the SpaceXAI artificial intelligence ecosystem. XAIW was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
